title: Aces Ale House

services.name: Private Event
services.desc: ACES Ale House features an indoor/outdoor space with the large back window being able to open to the private patio with bar seating on both sides. The beer hall includes its own bar, different seating options, TV, projector and A/V equipment. Wood accented walls, custom live wood tables and a gold accented dragon and barley mural bring this space to life. The perfect amount of space for baby showers, engagement parties, board meetings and viewing
